focus_areas: Limb digit count and structure (via Perceptual Quality Auditor)
Boundary sharpness between salamander and ground
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the yellow spots and black skin; AI often blurs this boundary. Verify that the 'gibberish' text is indeed an artifact and not a misinterpreted natural pattern. Ensure the parotoid glands are structurally integrated into the head and not floating blobs. Since animal_pose_auditor is excluded, rely heavily on perceptual_quality_auditor for limb integrity checks.
image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) on a textured, sandy ground. The salamander features a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow spots and patches. Its skin appears wet and glandular. The head is broad with visible parotoid glands. Forelimbs are clearly visible with distinct digits, while hindlimbs are partially obscured by the body angle. The tail extends towards the top left. There is illegible text/gibberish in the bottom right corner.
